title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode6 Grape-Picking Masters

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: Vineyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've all put on some bug repellent...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go pick ourselves some grapes!!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Within reason, we shall pick every type of grape which this vineyard has available and enjoy the rich flavors that they have to offer!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They both sound so excited.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, maybe a little too excited...
I mean, we're just here to pick some grapes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We could just get some from a supermarket and eat those.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho...
You just don't get it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the point of picking our own grapes isn't just to eat them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It looks like we, the masters of picking grapes, have no choice but to show you the way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Masters of picking grapes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! There is much to be gained from the act of picking your own grapes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What he said!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is this bit you're doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First, we must ask the growers about the signs of good grapes! Then, we are to spot the best ones using our own eyes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Imagine finding “the one”, picking the bunch and discovering that it's amazingly good! I wouldn't be able to contain my joy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In other words, the best part of all this is getting to feel really happy while having some yummy grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see...! That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, why do you two know so much about picking grapes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We actually got to do this as a family when we were little. I remember it being quite the learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how hard we tried that time?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We saw these grapes that looked really sweet and delicious, but they were up super high. Tsukasa and I managed to get them by having me sit on top of his shoulders!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember my legs wobbling quite a bit, but we got a hold of our tasty treasure in the end...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You wouldn't believe how incredible those grapes were! All the hard work we put in to get them made them taste just that much better!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, our original plan was to stuff our bags with as many grapes as we could! But after we got that bunch, we were totally satisfied...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: During the remaining time, we ended up just carrying it around like nothing else mattered.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's such a wonderful expression of how close you two are.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But does that really give you two the right to call yourselves “masters of picking grapes”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! Details, details!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've taught you the essentials regarding this matter, so let's start picking ourselves some grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright... Which grapes should I pick?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The growers said how the ones with the most color are the best, since it's proof that they've received plenty of nutrients.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
These ones look good.
Let's see... I'm supposed to cut...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, are you picking those?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, since they're a nice color.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree!
Oh, the bunch next to it also looks ripe. I think I'll pick those.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I wonder if she'll be able to manage it.
I've never really thought of her as having much of a green thumb...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'm supposed to firmly hold the stem and... There...
se_event_foliage_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, you made that look so easy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I think it's because I've been helping people on their farms and such for work. They've really taught me quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm glad she has some grapes now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now, as for mine... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What's wrong, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm having trouble cutting through this stem...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you may want to try holding the bunch more like this. That should help you cut all the way through.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, now try cutting it again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, lemme try...
se_event_foliage_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
These farming shears can be a little tricky to use.
I'm so glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had no idea... Thanks, Shizuku.
se_walk_men_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Saki and I have harvested a few bunches! How are you two doing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We each have one now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, the grapes you two picked look so plump and delicious♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they do! Anyway, now that we all have some, why don't we see how they taste?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We just gotta rinse them in some water, pick a grape off and... Do you have yours, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Shizuku, Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
Let's eat.
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I didn't realize how juicy grapes are when they're fresh off the vine...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmmmm! Aren't these amazing, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, they are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, what a spectacular scene!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our little sisters are enjoying grapes that they harvested together! I want to preserve this moment for eternity by hanging it up in a frame!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean...!
The way they're smiling as they have their grapes... I wish I could watch them forever.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, I know how to make that happen! If we keep picking grapes for them, then we'll get to keep watching them like this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, what are you saying...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's brilliant, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that means we have to find them the sweetest, most delicious grapes this vineyard has to offer! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-There they go...
<Haha! You both have siblings with way too much energy, Shih, Sakki☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiya! I've been watching from your pocket. Picking grapes together seems like so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, nice timing!
I was just about to call for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guess what? We've got enough grapes for everyone to have back in SEKAI! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
We really get to have these?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, I don't know if we'll be able to take all of these over, but get ready to have a bunch...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know!
What if we used these to throw a grape party in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<That's an amazing idea☆
As a member of the fun and games committee, I promise to help make it a great party!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, we could work with Hona to make grape parfaits, grape cake and grape juice!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And we can decorate a classroom with lots of grapes!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With grapes...? I feel like that's going too far...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Haha!
That's just one idea♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A grape party...
Then, that means we need to keep harvesting more!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, more?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well, duh!
If we're gonna have a party, then we're gonna need a lot more than this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I'm not about to let Tsukasa and Shizuku hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's have a competition to see who can pick the most!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If it's a competition, then I definitely don't want to lose.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, Shih, does this mean you're game?!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no way I'm letting you win!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I know I'm gonna pick the most delicious grapes in this vineyard!
